# Evaluation glossary
## Terms
- Owner note: the focused canonical document for a contract.
- Generated model: code rebuilt from synchronized schema.
- Editor preview: saved-draft component rendering.
- Page grid: layout aliases and ordered area slots.
- Application host: provisioning and startup dependency orchestration.
## Aliases
- DI: dependency injection.
- Base component: reusable design-system primitive.
